items.text: A save no longer stalls, and renames or moves no longer report Busy, when another writer releases a page at the moment Tine's page host goes to sleep: the host's path-lock retry could be dropped, leaving it waiting for an unrelated wake (internal: page-host driver lost wakeup).

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog coverage: REG-HOST-DRIVER-LOST-WAKEUP. Fail-before: proven on release/0.8 15462c3ee with the test hook and the old retry(): the new test fails (driver_tests.rs:649, save never resumed); the original flake failed 5/200 standalone. After: 0/300 and 0/30.. Gated on og and release/0.8 (Linux native journeys).

items.text: Settings → unused assets now keeps images referenced only by a duplicate journal file for the same day, including references in its page properties. Moving an asset to trash checks those files too, and refuses if one cannot be read or analyzed (audit L8-03).

items.text: A page being deleted stops accepting typing, paste, property and sheet edits until the delete answers. If deletion fails or is not confirmed, the page becomes editable again with its text intact; input can no longer slip past unsaved-text tracking during deletion (audit L9-06).

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog coverage: REG-AUDIT-L9-06-DELETE-INPUT. Fail-before: Proven on release/0.8 15462c3ee: five supplied audit L9-06 cases failed with untracked input or lost text; the normal-typing control passed. See RECEIPT-fix-l9-input.md.. Gated on og and release/0.8 (Linux native journeys).

items.text: A draft whose name is an alias is added to its owner only once even when the owner's save is not confirmed. A later edit replaces the landed copy instead of appending a second copy, and a refused landing keeps the draft recoverable (audit L9-05).
